reviews.text:
I want to thank Marta and Roberto for the wonderful time we had at Golfo's farewell. He spent 14 years at your clinic, and I will always be grateful to you for how kind and wonderful you are to our furry friends.

Above all, I want to thank Marta for all the help Golfo received from you ❤️ I will always be with you.
The love for animals is evident.
I've been bringing my cats here for years. Marta inspires a lot of confidence in me, and all the staff are very attentive and caring with the animals.
Nala was seen quickly, I heard great things about the clinic and it really is true, from now on they have a new patient.

I want to express my gratitude for the excellent care we received from the entire team at the clinic. My greyhound had been suffering from a very severe dry cough for two days, along with drooling and white foam coming from his mouth, and last night he worsened considerably, so we had to take him to the emergency clinic.

They attended to us very quickly, even though they had very few appointments available. They made time for us and treated us with professionalism and kindness. They explained everything to us about what was wrong with him and gave him the treatment he needed. Thanks to their attention, we now know what's wrong with my dog.

We are very grateful for the excellent care and dedication. Without a doubt, this is a highly recommended veterinary clinic.

They've been a huge help with my dog. She has a very special case because she has a neurobladder. Marta has been incredibly supportive when I needed it, and Silvia is a true expert with neurobladders. Thank you so much!
I've been there several times and the service is excellent. They're always friendly and willing to help, from the receptionist to the veterinarians. I highly recommend them. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent treatment for both me and my cat. Marta is incredibly professional, and after visiting several places, she found the perfect treatment. Thank you so much, I'm very grateful.
Excellent service! Thank you Marta for taking such good care of our Rigo! We'll be back!
Very good treatment! ☺️☺️ Excellent treatment of both animals.

Exorbitant prices
My dog ​​bit another dog, and the injured dog decided to come to this vet. Even though I have veterinary insurance and liability coverage, the vet refused to process the insurance claim. It was a fang bite to the ear; we weren't even at the clinic for 20 minutes. They also refused to let us split the bill.
